sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark (fill in the blanks, match the columns or true/false).

questions.q: Write True or False: (i) The surface area of a cube of edge a is 6a². (ii) The total surface area of a cone is πrl.
questions.answer:
(i) True: six square faces of area a² each.
(ii) False: πrl is the curved surface only; TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (i) A hemisphere whose volume and curved surface area are numerically equal has diameter ____. (ii) A cylindrical tank of capacity 6160 cm³ and diameter 28 cm has depth ____.
questions.answer:
(i) (2/3)πr³ = 2πr² ⇒ r = 3, so the diameter is 6 units.
(ii) r = 14: 22/7 × 196 × h = 6160 ⇒ 616h = 6160 ⇒ h = 10 cm.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: (i) The volume of a cube of surface area 150 cm² is ____. (ii) A cone and a cylinder with equal radii have equal curved surfaces; slant height of cone : height of cylinder = ____.
questions.answer:
(i) 6a² = 150 ⇒ a = 5 ⇒ V = 125 cm³.
(ii) πrl = 2πrh ⇒ l = 2h ⇒ l : h = 2 : 1.

questions.q: A solid metallic sphere of radius 21 cm is melted and recast into small cones of radius 7 cm and height 3 cm. Find the number of cones.
questions.answer:
Volume of sphere = (4/3)π × 21³ = (4/3)π × 9261 = 12348π.
Volume of one cone = ⅓π × 7² × 3 = 49π.
Number of cones = 12348π ÷ 49π = 252.

questions.q: A cube and a cuboid have the same volume; the cuboid's sides are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 4. The difference in the cost of polishing them at ₹5 per m² is ₹80. Find their volume.
questions.answer:
Cuboid sides x, 2x, 4x: volume 8x³, so the cube has edge 2x.
Cuboid TSA = 2(2x² + 8x² + 4x²) = 28x²; cube TSA = 6(2x)² = 24x².
Difference 4x² × 5 = 80 ⇒ x² = 4 ⇒ x = 2 m.
Volume = 8x³ = 64 m³.

questions.q: A hollow cylindrical pipe has external radius 9 cm and length 14 cm. The metal used is 748 cm³. Find the thickness of the metal.
questions.answer:
Volume of metal = πh(R² − r²) = 22/7 × 14 × (81 − r²) = 44(81 − r²).
44(81 − r²) = 748 ⇒ 81 − r² = 17 ⇒ r² = 64 ⇒ r = 8 cm.
Thickness = 9 − 8 = 1 cm.

questions.q: A conical tent is 6 m high with base radius 8 m. Find (i) its slant height (ii) the cloth needed (iii) its volume.
A hollow metal sphere of internal and external diameters 4 cm and 8 cm is melted and recast into a solid cone of base diameter 8 cm. Find the height of the cone.
A cylindrical container of diameter 12 cm and height 15 cm is full of ice-cream. It is filled into cones of height 12 cm and diameter 6 cm. How many cones can be filled?
questions.answer:
Cylinder: π × 6² × 15 = 540π.
One cone: ⅓π × 3² × 12 = 36π.
Number = 540π ÷ 36π = 15 cones.

questions.q: A solid toy is a hemisphere surmounted by a cone. The cone's height is 2 cm and the base diameter is 4 cm. Find the volume and surface area of the toy. (π = 22/7)
questions.answer:
r = 2 cm, cone height h = 2 cm, slant height l = √(4 + 4) = 2√2 ≈ 2.83 cm.
Volume = ⅓πr²h + (2/3)πr³ = ⅓π × 4 × 2 + (2/3)π × 8 = 8π/3 + 16π/3 = 8π ≈ 25.14 cm³.
Surface = cone CSA + hemisphere CSA = πrl + 2πr² = π × 2 × 2.83 + 2π × 4 = 17.78 + 25.14 ≈ 42.92 cm².

A milk tanker is a cylinder of diameter 2 m and length 4.2 m. It supplies its milk to two booths in the ratio 3 : 2. One booth has a cuboidal vessel with base area 3.96 m² and the other a cylindrical vessel of radius 1 m. Find the level of milk in each.
questions.answer:
Tanker volume = π × 1² × 4.2 = 22/7 × 4.2 = 13.2 m³.
Shares: 3/5 × 13.2 = 7.92 m³ and 2/5 × 13.2 = 5.28 m³.
Cuboidal vessel (gets 7.92): level = 7.92 ÷ 3.96 = 2 m.
Cylindrical vessel (gets 5.28): level = 5.28 ÷ (22/7 × 1²) = 1.68 m.
